title: dufresne.json
description: Project config written by `dufresne init`, read by `dufresne add`/`update`/`sync`. See https://github.com/enqrose/dufresne/blob/main/README.md#configuration.

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema for autocomplete/validation.

case.description: Filename casing for installed files, e.g. deep-merge.ts vs deepMerge.ts.

barrel.description: Maintain an index barrel file re-exporting each installed item.

comments.description: Keep the JSDoc header in added files. false strips it.

items.description: The declared set of items this project depends on. `add` appends to it; `sync` installs exactly this set.

aliases.description: Import specifiers that internal #utils/*, #helpers/* and #types/* references are rewritten to when an item is installed.

paths.description: On-disk destinations for installed files, relative to the project root.
